inheritedFieldLanguage.array: array=false is one scalar; array=true is an exact same-realm closed array of at most 256 elements; unique=true compares canonical JSON encodings
inheritedFieldLanguage.canonicalOrder: definition.fields is an array in ascending UTF-16 name order and is the exact closed-record member order

kinds.bounded-string: Unicode scalar string with 1..512 UTF-16 code units
kinds.json: closed JSON value snapshot; nestedRecords replaces this broad kind with the named schema where required
kinds.timestamp: canonical UTC RFC3339 with exactly three fractional digits

inheritedFieldLanguage.nullable: nullable=false rejects null; nullable=true accepts exactly null or the declared kind
inheritedFieldLanguage.values: null uses the kind rule; a nonempty unique array is the complete closed enum and every golden value must be a member

descriptorLanguage.array: array(<descriptor>,length=<positive-safe-decimal>,unique=<true|false>,order=<LEXICOGRAPHIC|PRESERVE|REGISTRY>) or array(<descriptor>,min=<safe-decimal>,max=<safe-decimal>,unique=<true|false>,order=<LEXICOGRAPHIC|PRESERVE|REGISTRY>); min<=max; no omitted bound, uniqueness, or order
descriptorLanguage.closed: closed(<named-record-id>) recursively resolves one member of nestedDefinitions and forbids unknown members
descriptorLanguage.enum: enum(<UPPER_OR_LOWER_TOKEN>[,<UPPER_OR_LOWER_TOKEN>...]); at least one distinct UTF-8 token, each 1..64 bytes, listed in lexicographic order
descriptorLanguage.fieldList: <lowerCamelField>:<descriptor>(|<lowerCamelField>:<descriptor>)* in ascending UTF-16 field-name order with no duplicate
descriptorLanguage.record: record(<public-schema-version>) recursively resolves one current public schema and requires its exact schemaVersion literal
descriptorLanguage.recursion: descriptors form a finite acyclic reference graph; recursive descent has maximum depth 32
descriptorLanguage.syntax: primitive | named-descriptor | literal(...) | enum(...) | nullable(...) | record(...) | closed(...) | array(...)

primitiveDescriptors.relative-path: UTF-8 1..1024 bytes; NFC; slash-separated relative path; no empty/dot/dot-dot segment, backslash, control, drive, URI, or absolute prefix
primitiveDescriptors.safe-decimal: 0|[1-9][0-9]*; compare length then lexicographically with 9007199254740991 before any Number conversion
primitiveDescriptors.timestamp: canonical UTC RFC3339 with exactly three fractional digits
primitiveDescriptors.token: UTF-8 1..128 bytes; NFC; matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@+/-]*; never rendered as free-form prose

attemptLogStorage.construction: validate ordinal as safe-decimal before conversion; path = installation/activation-recovery-launches/<transaction>/<source>/attempt-log/<ordinal>.json; construct ordinal n+1 from n; never enumerate

publicExports.extractor: public-export-census/v1: parse named export clauses and direct exported declarations in index.ts; expand only the exact export-type-star runtime.ts clause; reject any other export-star, alias, duplicate, or unsupported syntax
